title: Korea's constitution says the Republic is a democratic republic and that authority emanates from the people
summary: Korea's constitution says the Republic is a democratic republic and that authority emanates from the people.
body: Article 1 says the Republic of Korea shall be a democratic republic, and that sovereignty resides in the people and all state authority emanates from the people. The source says: "GENERAL PROVISIONS Article 1 Type of government envisioned The Republic of Korea shall be a democratic republic." Both clauses are in Article 1 of the English compilation.
